awards.line: Brooks Lee went 2-for-5, HR, 3 RBI, 1 run.

awards.label: Top Hitter
awards.line: Brooks Lee went 2-for-5, HR, 3 RBI, 1 run.

paragraphs: 5 former Mustangs appeared in professional games on Friday for 5 clubs across 3 levels, with Brooks Lee producing the night's most notable performance.

Brooks Lee's home run — his 22th of the season came in the first inning on a 3-2 95 mph four-seam fastball from Luis Castillo. The swing moved the score from 0-4 to 2-4. Statcast measured the ball at 103.4 mph off the bat, a 38-degree launch angle, 380 feet.
Brooks Lee tied the game in the second with a single to left field on a 1-0 86 mph slider from Luis Castillo, changing the score from 3-4 to 4-4.
Brooks Lee went 2-for-5, 1 home run, 3 RBI, 1 run scored.
He batted second and started at third base.
Minnesota Twins fell to Chicago White Sox, 4-7.

Ryan Stafford went 0-for-3, 1 run scored, 1 stolen base for Frederick Keys at High-A. Ryan Stafford put his club in front in the second with a go-ahead ball put in play toward shortstop on a 3-2 pitch from Adam Shoemaker, changing the score from 0-0 to 1-0. He batted eighth and started at designated hitter. Frederick Keys beat Asheville Tourists, 4-2.

Alejandro Garza went 2-for-4, 1 double, 1 run scored, 1 stolen base for Hill City Howlers at Single-A. Alejandro Garza produced a double in the seventh to left field on a 1-2 pitch from Frankeli Arias. He batted first and started at second base. Hill City Howlers beat Kannapolis Cannon Ballers, 5-1.

Ryan Tayman went 1-for-4, 1 double, 1 run scored for St. Lucie Mets at Single-A. Ryan Tayman produced a double in the seventh to center field on a 0-2 pitch from Justin Henschel. He batted third and started behind the plate. St. Lucie Mets fell to Daytona Tortugas, 5-6.
Zach Daudet went 0-for-4 for Asheville Tourists at High-A. He batted fifth and started at shortstop. Asheville Tourists fell to Frederick Keys, 2-4.
title: Brooks Lee delivers in a key spot
